key_insight: A frozen medical AI can keep improving after deployment by learning from experience through external skill, knowledge, and multimodal memory rather than retraining its weights.
clinical_relevance: This could help clinical AI stay aligned with changing evidence, workflows, and case patterns while preserving prior performance.
method: Adds a Skill module for reasoning and tool use.
Stores reliable facts in a Knowledge Memory backed by prior cases or trusted evidence.
Uses a Multimodal Knowledge Base to retain visual examples and match them to new images, with updates accepted only if they improve new cases without harming earlier ones.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on six benchmarks across clinical diagnosis, workflows, reasoning, and visual reasoning using four open-weight and closed-source base models, with gains up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks.
watch_item: Because the approach depends on external memories and online validation, real-world deployment may still face retrieval quality, update governance, and drift-monitoring challenges.
paper_title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
